summary: First iteration of PadelConnect. Comprehensive backend + frontend testing performed. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passing (auth, clubs, regions, suggest-club, announcements, messages/conversations, ratings). Frontend: Expo web preview loads correctly, sign-in with marc@padel.fr works and redirects to Clubs tab, 12 clubs render with horizontal region chips, search input present, club detail opens with Annonces/Infos segment, announcement composer posts and message displays in feed with author enriched (MarcPadel, Confirmé, 0.0 stars), Messages tab lists the JulieSmash conversation with last DM, Profile tab navigates. All primary user flows functional.

minor.issue: Suggested club is inserted with approved=false and NOT returned in GET /api/clubs (which filters approved:true). The author cannot see their own suggestion anywhere — comment says 'awaiting moderation, but list to author' but that logic is missing. Consider adding a $or with suggested_by=me, or a separate /api/clubs/mine endpoint.

ui_bugs.issue: Email/Password TextInput and 'Se connecter' Pressable lack testID attributes (had to use nth-child selectors). Recommend adding testID='signin-email', 'signin-password', 'signin-submit' for reliable automated testing.
Not verified but likely missing same testIDs — please add signup-email/pseudo/password/submit.

issues: The announcement composer input row overlays the bottom of the feed with no visible separator/shadow — content can scroll under it. Consider a top border or shadow on the composer bar (KeyboardAvoidingView appears OK).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Non-blocking but should be migrated to boxShadow for web / keep native shadowColor separately.

action_items: Add testID attributes on sign-in and sign-up inputs & submit button (signin-email, signin-password, signin-submit, signup-email, signup-pseudo, signup-password, signup-submit).

Fix suggest-club visibility: either include suggested_by=current_user in GET /api/clubs, or show a message 'En attente de modération' after suggestion in the modal (the create response returns 200 so UX-side you may already do this — please confirm).
Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow (web) to silence RN Web warning.
Optional: add a subtle top border or elevation to the club-detail announcement composer bar.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_conversation returns raw msg objects without a Pydantic model — response contains internal 'conv_id' field which is fine but consider trimming.
reliability_avg computed only in user_public() — good; PUT /auth/me correctly re-fetches user then returns user_public.
JWT_SECRET read from env with hard KeyError if missing (good fail-fast). Confirmed present.
All endpoints correctly return 200/401/404/409/422. MongoDB _id is excluded in projections. Pydantic validation enforces password min_length=6 (register returns 422 for short pw).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all primary flows verified end-to-end (login, clubs list, region chips, search, club detail, announcement post, messages list, profile navigation). Only cosmetic/testID gaps.

seed_data_creation: None persisted intentionally. Tests created TEST_-prefixed users, one TEST_Club_* suggested club (unapproved, hidden), one announcement 'TEST announcement <hex>' in first club, and a DM 'TEST DM <hex>' Marc→Julie. These remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (https://padel-play-8.preview.emergentagent.com). Demo creds marc@padel.fr / password123 and julie@padel.fr / password123. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_padelconnect.py. All existing testIDs on Clubs tab: suggest-club-button, clubs-search-input, region-chip-*, club-card-<uuid>. Missing testIDs on sign-in/sign-up inputs. Frontend uses Expo Router with routes: /sign-in, /sign-up, / (Clubs), /messages, /profile, /club/[id], /chat/[id], /player/[id], /suggest-club, /edit-profile.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failing tests. Only minor UX/testID gaps documented above.
